landing.eyebrowFr: For gîtes, B&Bs and romantic suites in France
landing.title: The welcome guide that answers your guests, even without signal.
landing.leadQc: Door code, Wi-Fi, wood stove, hot tub, snow removal, emergencies: all in a bilingual guide your guests open from a QR code, with no app.
landing.leadFr: Codes, Wi-Fi, hot tub, pool, waste sorting, emergencies: all in a bilingual guide your guests open from a QR code, with no app.
landing.phoneLabel: Demo guide shown in a phone
landing.b1Text: Wi-Fi, check-out time, garbage: the guide and its assistant answer for you, day and night.
landing.b2Text: A link or a QR code is enough. The guide works offline, even where cell coverage doesn’t.
landing.b3Text: Firewood, late check-out, local food basket: your extras are offered at the right moment of the stay.
landing.uniqueTitle: Built for your type of property
landing.uQcModulesText: Wood stove, hot tub, septic and well, snow removal, bears and garbage, municipal by-laws.
landing.uFrModulesText: Hot tub and water-quality log, pool, waste sorting, tourist tax, neighbour rules.
landing.uOfflineText: After the first visit, codes, guidance and emergencies stay available with no signal.
landing.uBilingualText: French and English, one tap to switch. Your content is entered or translated in both.
landing.uAirbnbText: For an Airbnb booking, an extra becomes a request: no off-platform payment.
landing.uLiveTextQc: Weather, Environment Canada alerts, road closures and fire danger around the cottage.
landing.uLiveTextFr: Local weather and links to official warnings around the property.
landing.uStatsText: A simple monthly report: questions answered without you, sections read, extras requested.
landing.spaTitle: Got a hot tub? That’s our speciality.
landing.spaText: For guests: clear guidelines (shower, duration, children, cover, cloudy water). For you: a self-check log, maintenance reminders, log export and the latest results shown by QR code.
landing.s1TextQc: Search your name or CITQ number: the guide is pre-filled with the public information from your listing.
landing.s1TextFr: Pick a template suited to your gîte, B&B or romantic suite.
landing.s2Text: Codes, Wi-Fi, guidance: the editor guides you field by field and shows the result on a phone.
landing.s3Title: Share the link or QR code
landing.s3Text: Send the link before arrival and display the QR code at the entrance. Update it anytime.
landing.demosLead: Open a demo guide on your phone: everything is fictional, but everything works.
landing.pricingNote: Indicative launch prices, taxes extra. No payment in this demo.
landing.contactLead: Leave us a few words: we’ll show you your guide in 15 minutes.
landing.formDemo: Demo form: nothing is sent or stored.
landing.sentText: This demo sends no email. To reach us, write to us directly:
landing.sentNoEmail: The contact address will appear here (set it in src/config.ts).
